name: Triumph of Orthodoxy
summary: Empress regent Theodora restores the veneration of icons in a synod presided by Patriarch Methodius. The 'Triumph of Orthodoxy' is thereafter commemorated annually on the first Sunday of Great Lent.

_quarry.structural_significance: Ends the second iconoclast period and the broader iconoclast controversy permanently; consolidates the visual culture of Byzantine and later Orthodox Christianity around the icon.
